reports/full_data_extension/final-evalua.question: Does the frozen within-collection comparison retain its class-coverage and alert-burden conclusions on the held-out official39 split?
interpretation_limits: Three training seeds, one fixed simulated client partition; no significance or equivalence claim.
Extensive validation reuse; test is within the same collection, not unseen-session evidence.
Input overlap screening does not eliminate near-duplicate or feature-construction shortcuts.
All original test metrics remain secondary; no score-dependent exclusions or population changes.
No matched official39 heavy model; legacy46 results and paper binary scores are not direct controls.
No physical-edge latency, memory or energy measurement; no privacy guarantee or per-device vulnerability claim.
Completing final evaluation closes model selection for this holdout; further development needs a new independent evaluation design.
